verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs show a broad agent-building framework (custom agents, Models API, @mention-able agents) that could be configured to analyze board data and surface insights, but there is no direct evidence of a native, out-of-the-box 'AI insights/suggestions' feature analyzing user data automatically — it's framed as an agent platform you build/configure rather than built-in analytics. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic insight/summary generation from board data, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these AI features work well in practice.
